raw_message.reasoning:
I see the issue. The expression `([^ ]*)\\.*world` means:
- `([^ ]*)` - capture one or more non-space characters (this captures 'hello...')
- `\\.*` - zero or more literal dots (fill pattern)
- `world` - literal text

The problem is that `[^ ]*` matches all non-space characters including the dots, so it captures 'hello...' instead of just 'hello'.
